sop_title: KYB Onboarding Review: Level 1 Standard Operating Procedure

sop.text: When more than one section applies, the most severe outcome governs: Decline, then Escalate, then Request documents, then Incomplete, then Approve.
A fact that has not been established is unknown, not false. If any fact required by this procedure is unknown, the case cannot be approved.

Entities on the excluded list do not require beneficial owners to be identified. The list is the 16 entity types in 31 CFR 1010.230(e)(2), for example regulated banks, SEC-registered issuers, registered investment companies and state-regulated insurance companies.

For every other entity, identify one control person: a single individual with significant responsibility to control, manage or direct the entity. If no control person is identified, request documents.

Unless the entity is excluded or is a nonprofit, identify every individual who owns 25% or more of the entity, directly or indirectly. Ownership is complete only when no unidentified person could own 25% or more, given the shares that are unaccounted for or held through entities whose owners are unknown. If an excluded entity owns 25% or more, no individual needs to be identified for that share. If ownership is not complete, request documents.
Verify the identity of every identified individual. If any is unverified, request documents.
The entity's registry filing must be less than 12 months old. Otherwise request documents.
A confirmed sanctions match on the entity or any identified individual: decline.
A potential sanctions match that has not been cleared: escalate.
A politically exposed person among the identified individuals: escalate.

Adverse media on the entity or any identified individual: escalate. Adverse media counts only if it is material. A report counts only if it matches the name and at least one other identifier (age, location or role), and comes from a court record, a regulator or an established news outlet, or from two independent other sources. Record every search: the terms, the date and the sources reviewed.
Prohibited industries (marijuana-related business, adult content, unlicensed money transmission): decline.
Restricted industries (money services businesses, virtual currency): escalate.
Licensed money services businesses whose state licence has been verified may be approved.
The entity or any identified individual is located in a comprehensively sanctioned country: decline.
The entity or any identified individual is located in a FATF high-risk or increased-monitoring jurisdiction: escalate.

findings.title: 5.2 treats an unknown fact differently from 2.2
findings.example: licence verified is unknown. If licence verified turned out "yes", 5.2 would not apply.
findings.explain: In this case 5.2 leads to escalate only because a fact is unknown. 2.2 says a case with an unknown fact is incomplete, and 2.1 ranks escalate above incomplete, so 5.2 wins.

proof.asks: Is there a case with up to 6 items in each list that 5.2 decides, but that it would not apply to, and that would come out differently, once its unknown facts are known?
proof.code: solver.add(completes(c, known), applies("industry-restricted", c), outcome(c).eq("escalate"), Not(applies("industry-restricted", known)), outcome(known).neq("escalate"))

findings.question: A money services business has applied, and no one has yet established whether its state licence is verified. Should it go to Enhanced Due Diligence now, or go back as incomplete until the licence check is done?
options: No, finish the licence check first

option_edits.says: Under 5.2, a money services business goes to EDD while its state licence check is still open, so it is escalated rather than treated as incomplete under 2.2.

option_edits.option: No, finish the licence check first
option_edits.says: 5.2 escalates a money services business only once its state licence check has failed; while the check is still open, the case is incomplete under 2.2 and goes back for investigation.

When excluded is "yes" and industry is "msb" and licence verified is "yes" (and 4 other facts are as listed), and everything else is unknown, the case now comes out escalate (5.2) and would come out approve (5.3).

When 1 person is listed and excluded is "no" and industry is unknown and control person for person 1 is "yes" and id verified for person 1 is unknown, and everything else is unknown, the case now comes out request docs (3.4) and would come out incomplete (2.2).
